title: End of line pick and place unit

features.item: A housing with a grip portion for gripping and an electrically operated vacuum generating device
features.quote: [paragraph 0017] According to a preferred embodiment, the grippers are vacuum operated, i.e. the vacuum provides the connection between the grippers and the package to be transported.
features.note: The reference discloses vacuum-operated grippers and a gripper unit with a housing, but does not explicitly state that the housing itself has a grip portion for gripping or that the vacuum generating device is electrically operated.

features.item: The grip portion is a hollow body
features.note: The reference does not describe the grip portion as a hollow body.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device is guided through the grip portion to an air outlet
features.note: The reference does not describe exhaust air being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet.

features.item: A sound-damping device is arranged in the grip portion
features.note: The reference does not mention a sound-damping device in the grip portion.

features.item: A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device in grip portion
features.note: The reference does not disclose a grip unit with all these specific features, particularly the hollow grip portion, exhaust air routing through the grip, and a sound-damping device in the grip portion.

features.item: A vacuum handling apparatus comprising a suction plate with carrier plate and seal, and a grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device
features.note: The reference describes a gripper unit with vacuum grippers and a tool (plate) but lacks the specific details of a hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routing, and sound-damping device.

features.item: The grip portion is at least partially lined with sound-damping material
features.note: The reference does not mention the grip portion being lined with sound-damping material.

features.item: The vacuum generating device is arranged completely in a first housing portion
features.quote: [abstract] The present invention relates to a gripper unit (6) comprising a housing (20) at which a tool (12) is releasably provided, that comprises all grippers (7) for a specific application.
features.note: The reference discloses a gripper unit with a housing, and vacuum-operated grippers, implying a vacuum generating device. However, it does not specify that the vacuum generating device is arranged completely within a 'first housing portion' or describe such a multi-part housing structure.

features.item: A sound-reducing device is arranged in the first housing portion or the first housing portion is lined with sound-reducing material
features.note: The reference does not mention any sound-reducing device or lining in any housing portion.

features.item: The grip portion is elongated between the first housing portion and a second housing portion, with air outlet on the second housing portion
features.note: The reference does not describe an elongated grip portion between two housing portions with an air outlet on the second housing portion.

features.item: An air collection screw arranged upstream of the grip portion in the first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
features.note: The reference does not mention an air collection screw or any specific mechanism for collecting exhaust air upstream of a grip portion.

features.item: Bent or curved air baffles downstream of the grip portion for guiding exhaust air to the air outlet
features.note: The reference does not describe bent or curved air baffles for guiding exhaust air.

features.item: A battery coupling point on the second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from the battery coupling point
features.note: The reference does not mention a battery coupling point or air baffles directing exhaust air away from it.

features.item: The grip unit and suction plate are releasably connected via a coupling device
features.quote: [paragraph 0018] The problem is also solved with a gripper unit, preferably for the inventive end of line unit, wherein the gripper unit comprises a housing at which a tool is releasably provided, which comprises all grippers for a specific
features.note: The reference explicitly states that a tool, which comprises the grippers (acting as a suction plate), is releasably provided at the housing of the gripper unit.
features.refuted: The quote is incomplete and cuts off mid-sentence, failing to establish any connection between a grip unit and suction plate via a coupling device.

features.item: The grip unit has a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber delimited by the suction plate
features.quote: [paragraph 0036] As can particularly seen from Figure 5 , at the tool, preferably a central connector 17 is provided. This connector can be connected to a vacuum-source and downstream from the connector 17, tubes 18 are provided, which connect
features.note: The reference discloses a central connector and tubes connecting to individual grippers (suction elements), implying a fluidic connection for vacuum. However, it does not explicitly describe a 'suction opening' on a 'grip unit' fluidically connected to a 'suction chamber delimited by the suction plate'.

claims.note: The reference describes a gripper unit for an end-of-line pick and place unit, not a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device.

claims.quote: The present invention relates to a gripper unit (6) comprising a housing (20) at which a tool (12) is releasably provided, that comprises all grippers (7) for a specific application.
claims.note: The reference discloses a gripper unit comprising a housing and grippers that are vacuum operated, but it does not specify an electrically operated vacuum generating device within the housing, nor a grip portion for gripping the unit.
The reference does not describe a grip portion designed as a hollow body.
The reference does not describe exhaust air being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet.
The reference describes a gripper unit for pick and place operations, but it does not mention a sound-damping device arranged in a grip portion or any sound-damping features at all.
The reference does not mention a grip portion being lined with a sound-damping material.
The reference describes a gripper unit with a housing, but it does not specify a vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion.
The reference does not mention a sound-reducing device in a housing portion or a housing portion lined with sound-reducing material.
This reference does not discuss a grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions, nor an air outlet arranged on a second housing portion.
This reference does not describe an air collection device in the form of an air collection screw, nor its arrangement upstream of a grip portion in a first housing portion for collecting exhaust air.
This reference does not mention bent or curved air baffles arranged downstream of a grip portion or in a second housing portion for guiding exhaust air.
This reference does not describe a battery coupling point for an electrical energy storage device or rechargeable battery on a housing or second housing portion.
The reference does not disclose air baffles for directing exhaust air away from a battery coupling point.

claims.quote: The present invention relates to an end of line pick and place unit with an infeed conveyer which transports n packages side by side in one row towards a gripper unit
claims.note: The reference describes an 'end of line pick and place unit' which functions as a vacuum handling apparatus.
claims.refuted: The quote describes a pick and place unit with a gripper unit, not a vacuum handling apparatus.

claims.note: The reference does not describe a suction plate comprising a carrier plate and a seal fastened to and extending around it.

claims.quote: The present invention relates to a gripper unit (6) comprising a housing (20) at which a tool (12) is releasably provided, that comprises all grippers (7) for a specific application.
claims.note: The reference discloses a gripper unit with a housing and releasable tool with grippers, but the full scope of 'said grip unit according to claim 1' is not provided in the reference text.

claims.quote: [abstract] The present invention relates to a gripper unit (6) comprising a housing (20) at which a tool (12) is releasably provided, that comprises all grippers (7) for a specific application.
claims.note: This passage discloses a gripper unit with a releasably provided tool, which is analogous to a grip unit and suction plate being releasably connected. However, it does not explicitly mention a coupling device.

claims.quote: For picking up the packages, the gripper unit is lowered until the grippers touch the packages. Then, a vacuum is applied between the packages and the grippers 7.
claims.note: This passage describes vacuum being applied between packages and grippers to pick them up, which implies a vacuum being generated to lift an object. However, it does not explicitly mention a suction opening, a suction chamber, or a suction plate.

overall.why: The reference describes a pick and place unit with a gripper unit that uses vacuum-operated grippers and has a releasable tool (plate) with grippers, which aligns with some aspects of the subject invention's vacuum handling apparatus.
